title: Dated AECPSED1 certificates (types 4, 8, 9)
blocker: All three dated options are mapped to the current TGSS form fields, with offline coverage of the resulting requests. Acceptance of an actual dated issuance is still unverified.
unblock: When a dated certificate is genuinely needed, provide the holder, kind, reference date and any contracting entity, and authorize that issuance so the response and PDF can be verified.
notes: field of the request is captured.

2026-11-27: An authorized login stopped at the AECPSED1 entry. The official active XSL and toggle script exposed option 4 as fechaNegativo, option 8 as fechaLicitacionSinDeuda plus nifLicitacionSinDeuda, and option 9 as fechaSubvencionSinDeuda. These controls use DD/MM/YYYY from 01/01/1980 through yesterday. The CLI and library now map and validate the inputs before authentication. No certificate was requested or issued in the live check. TGSS manual: https://sede.seg-social.gob.es/binarios/es/1608CerEmp.
